method: Original target, baseline and all 11 blockout frames inspected before source. Subjective visual scores for the compact game asset.

pixelFindings: The rear main roof sheet disappears in clay-rear, exposing shell/trim bands while beauty remains filled.
Far annex corner post stops short of the lean-to underside in front-left and rear-left, leaving a visible small gap.
boundedCorrection.sourceDiagnosisAfterPixels: Main side +1 and -1 roof meshes reuse the same winding; one therefore has inward normals. Annex lean-to triangle winding is downward. DoubleSide beauty materials conceal the culling issue. Dormer roof normals should be audited in the same bounded fix.
boundedCorrection.hypothesis: Orient every roof face outward and fit annex corner posts to the lean-to underside without changing frozen roof/shell silhouettes or openings.
boundedCorrection.controls: Same 11 camera frames; no finish additions until macro passes.
boundedCorrection.requiredDelta: Every critical score at least 0.85; worst dimension improves by at least 0.10; no critical regression over 0.05.

views.cottage-world-azimuth-0: Conifer intersects/obscures annex and terrace; grass enters the front approach.
views.cottage-world-azimuth-90: Neighboring cottage occludes lower annex. Outer eave is very close to neighbor side; clearance not proven.
views.cottage-world-azimuth-180: Pointed terrain rock protrudes into rear service-door threshold. Broad terrace is supported by coastline. Annex-to-neighbor contact remains too close for confident approval.
views.cottage-world-azimuth-270: Lighthouse occludes lower cottage; exposed roofs appear separated, without a demonstrated intersection.

assembly.correctionScope: Clear local conifer/grass from cottage footprint and entrances, and remove only the rear threshold terrain intrusion. Preserve frozen neighbor buildings. Supply unobstructed or bounding-surface evidence for annex outer eave versus cottage-02 wall/gutter before assembly approval.
assembly.note: Projected overlaps alone are not treated as confirmed architectural collisions.

remainingTargetGap: Finish deliberately absent. Target weathering, roof courses, shutters, flower boxes and hardware are not evaluated at macro stage.
